title: Sherpa blankets
text: Sherpa blankets. They said this was going to be a really thick blanket and Superior Quality the blanket I purchased in October was half the price a much thicker and a better quality it's a beautiful blanket love the pattern that was one of the things that intrigue me about it sorely disappointed with the quality of it not worth the price I paid but I'll keep it none the less because I don't feel like shipping it back but the one I purchased earlier for $19 was a far superior and thicker blanket
